item.title: Pretty interior! Circa 1948 in North Carolina. $278,000
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! The home was built in 1948. It is located on .38 acre in Enfield, North Carolina. The house features a covered side porch, chair rails, crown moulding, paneled wainscoting, crystal chandelier, updated kitchen, coffered ceiling, built-in bookshelves, bead board and a brick fireplace. There is a fenced in backyard with a patio area and a detached storage shed. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,294 square feet. $278,000 Contact Sterling Grimes with Foote Real Esta

item.title: Pretty setting and great screened in porch! Over five acres in Virginia. $299,797
item.description: Pretty setting! I love the screened in porch! The sellers had horses and chickens at this property. The house was built in 1925. It is located in 5.37 acres in Gum Spring, Virginia. The house could use some updating and undoing of past renovations. The house features shake siding, small covered porch, screened in back porch, wood floors, brick hearth, exposed beams, crown moulding and baseboards. item.title: Want the kitchen sink! C. 1930. Riverfront in Ohio. $347,500
item.description: I want that kitchen sink! Curious what is going on with the backyard. I am suspecting that river can be an issue. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .77 acres in Fremont, Ohio. The house features wood floors, built-in bookshelves, a lot of natural light, pretty sunroom, crown moulding, large fireplace, arched entryway, large back patio, finished basement and a back upper porch. item.title: TWO houses on 20 acres in North Carolina. Has a private hiking trail! $299,000
item.description: Pretty creek! This property has nice acreage and a private hiking trail! I would love to have that. The listing consists of two houses. The earliest was built in 1930. It is located on 20.21 acres in Cullowhee, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, built-in bookshelves, vaulted ceiling, crown moulding and exposed log walls in the laundry room. item.title: Pretty setting! Almost three acres in Virginia. $129,900
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! If you pull up street view, it looks like a quiet country road. Big old trees on the lot. The house was built in 1950. It is located on 2.83 acres in Long Island, Virginia. The house could use some work, but it looks livable. I would do a thorough cleaning and work room by room. There is an outbuilding on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,176 square feet. $129,900 Contact Charlie Watts with Watts Auction Realty: 434-942-0840 From the Zillow listin

item.description: Love this yard! Pretty landscaping! Great views too! The house was built in 1951. It is located on 1.16 acres in Roseburg, Oregon. The house features a front porch, pretty landscaping, stone walkways, wood floors, brick hearth, built-ins and a sunroom. There is an attached two car garage. item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1920. Over two acres in Pennsylvania. $790,000
item.description: This house has a lot of pretty details! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 2.17 acres in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania. The house features custom tile flooring, stone fireplace, built-in corner china cabinets, crown moulding, wood floors, exposed beams and multiple patios. The home sits about Gulph Creek. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 4,089 square feet. $790,000 Contact Marion Dinofa with Compass Real Estate: 610-914-1144 From the Zillow listing: Unique and jaw-dropping Revolution-er
